subject: คณิตศาสตร์
level: โอลิมปิก (สอวน.)

units.title: Sharp angle bound from dominance of subtended obtuse angles
units.statement: Let P=(0,0), Q=(0,1), R=(u,v) with v>0, and 90°<θ<180°. If every pair A,B on the horizontal line subtending θ at R subtends at least θ at Q, then v>1 and |u|≤−cot(θ)(v−1). Conversely those inequalities imply the condition. Thus the least possible angle PQR is 270°−θ, attained along either boundary ray of the wedge.
steps: Write A=(m−h,0), B=(m+h,0) and express their angle at R with a cotangent identity
Let m tend to both infinities to obtain v>1 and |u|≤−cot(θ)(v−1)
Use the same identity to prove the wedge sufficient and optimize angle PQR
